text:
deploy-bot: queued deploy: config-only change `config-3334` -> routing weights + batching params. change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. canary plan: 5% 10m -> 30% over 20m. submitter: sam
sam: ack. i'll watch the canary. tagging @oncall and @eva :eyes:
eva: quick sanity — planned tiny_batch_window from 12ms -> 8ms for small tenants; also lowering tenant_rate_floor 50->40 QPS. confirm these don't break rhythm for large seqs
marco: small ask: add a traffic_slew param to smooth ramp, prefer 2% steps every 2m rather than a single jump
sam: done, added `slew_steps: 10, step_interval: 120s` to the rollout block
deploy-bot: canary started: config-3334-canary id=cb-9001. routing pinned to model v1.2 for canary traffic
oncall: seeing a transient p95 bump on one pod cluster-a: 220ms -> investigating logs
sam: paste logs: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --since=5m` showed repeated GC pauses and some OOMKilled events in that pod
eva: if this persists >2% error or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m we should rollback. outline rollback: revert routing pin + redeploy previous config (config-3333) and abort ramp
marco: i can try a mitigation before rollback — bump kv_cache_ttl from 30s -> 60s and nudge tiny_batch to 10ms to reduce KVC pressure
sam: go for it, make it a patch so we keep canary lineage
marco: pushed `config-3334-patch1` (tiny_batch_window: 10ms, kv_cache_ttl: 60s). applied to canary group
deploy-bot: canary updated: patch applied to cb-9001. monitoring dashboards: https://ops.redwood.internal/d/ci-ops/config-rollout?panelId=7
oncall: after patch p95 returned to baseline within 4m, no new OOMs on that pod. errors stable at 0.3%
eva: good. keep canary at 5% for full 10m then proceed to ramp to 30% per plan
sam: keeping watch. will notif if anything odd. thanks @marco for the quick patch
deploy-bot: ramping per slew: 2% steps every 2min. next milestone: 30% at +30m
marco: note for postmortem: add KV cache telemetry to the canary dashboard, we had low visibility there
sam: agreed — i'll add to release notes and follow-up ticket
eva: release notes draft: - reason: routing/batching tuning for small-tenant latency/costs
  - changes: tiny_batch_window 12ms->8ms (canary then patched to 10ms), tenant_rate_floor 50->40 QPS, kv_cache_ttl 30s->60s, traffic_slew added
  - rollout: canary 5% -> 30% with 2% steps every 2m
  - rollback conditions: >2% errors OR p95 > 2x baseline for 10m -> revert to config-3333 and pin routing
sam: ramp complete, no anomalies in 30m. marking rollout successful
deploy-bot: rollout complete: config-3334 active at 100%. release notes link: https://confluence.redwood/release/config-3334
oncall: leaving a quick ops note: watch kv_cache miss-rate for 24h. set alert threshold: miss-rate > 1.5x baseline
marco: opened follow-up ticket INF-4827 for long-term kvcache metrics and dashboard work
sam: added final release note bullets and shipped the confluence page. Thanks all :tada:
